fabricationFlags: Aquinas Hall description in catalog ('upper-class apartment-style suites with kitchens') contradicts official source: Aquinas is a first-year suite-style hall housing the Honors Living Learning Community, with only a kitchenette lounge, not full kitchens.

Mitty Hall described in catalog as 'upper-class suite-style' but official source lists Mitty among first-year residence halls; first-year vs upper-class classification appears mixed/uncertain across catalog accommodation entries.

Scholarship dollar amounts (Lasallian Leadership up to $5,000/yr, Alumni Legacy up to $2,000/yr, Robert W. Summers $6,000/yr, Macken Forensics $5,000/yr, International Student Merit up to $25,000/yr) could not be verified against an official scholarships page (target scholarship pages returned HTTP 404); amounts are plausible but unverified.
Average aid package figure '$46,832 for Fall 2025' and '91% of students receive aid' stated in scholarship description but not verified against official source.

Trailing 8 catalog program entries (language 'ru', verified:true) are scraped page titles, not real degree programs (e.g. 'Master Artist VI: Stephen De Staebler, a Thirty-Year Survey 1973-2003' is a museum exhibition, not an academic program; 'Counseling, MA Frequently Asked Questions', 'Master's in Leadership Plan of Study' are sub-pages). These are mislabeled as level 'master' degrees.

Several graduate tuition figures (MBA $48,000, MS CS $42,000, MAT $36,000, etc.) are flat estimates not verified; official catalog states graduate tuition differs by program and directs students to contact each program.
evidence: Official site stmarys-ca.edu confirmed. Tuition: catalog & financial-aid pages confirm 2026-2027 full-time undergraduate (non-BSN) tuition & fees = $61,416 and BSN nursing = $76,770 — EXACT match to catalog byProgram values. (Catalog historical page showed 2025-2026 base tuition $59,251; the $61,416 reflects the newer 2026-2027 rate, accurate.) Programs: program-finder confirms the four real schools (Liberal Arts, Science, Economics & Business Administration, Kalmanovitz School of Education) and majors incl. Accounting, Business Administration, Business Analytics, Data Science, Art History, Art Practice, Communication, Creative Writing, Dance, Digital Media Art, Biochemistry, Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science — all genuine SMC majors; ~40 undergraduate majors claim is consistent. The first ~45 degree entries are accurate; the last 8 'ru' entries are scraped non-program page titles (red flag). Campuses: Moraga 420-acre single campus, address 1928 St. Marys Rd Moraga CA 94575, Spanish Colonial Revival / California Churrigueresque architecture — all consistent with official material. Accommodation: residence halls Augustine, Aquinas, De La Salle, Mitty, Justin all confirmed real SMC halls; however catalog's first-year vs upper-class labeling and Aquinas 'apartment-style with kitchens' detail contradict official housing pages (Aquinas is suite-style first-year/Honors hall, kitchenette only). Scholarships: named awards plausible but scholarship pages returned 404; dollar amounts and aid statistics unverified.
